# An sse route's call may take the result of another call. That call runs
# before the event stream opens; when it returns an error the route
# responds 500 and does not open the stream. The nested call takes the same
# arguments as one on a plain route, request among them, and may sit before
# a path value.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events/{id} sse(Stream(ctx, Count(ctx, id), execute))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /gated/{id} sse(Stream(ctx, Gate(request, id), execute))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /sessions/{id} sse(Watch(ctx, Session(request), id, execute))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"errors"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Count(ctx context.Context, id int) (int, error) {
	if id < 0 {
		return 0, errors.New("no count for a negative id")
	}
	return id * 2, nil
}

func (Server) Gate(request *http.Request, id int) (int, error) {
	if request.Header.Get("Authorization") == "" {
		return 0, errors.New("unauthorized")
	}
	return id + 1, nil
}

func (Server) Session(request *http.Request) string {
	return request.Header.Get("Session")
}

func (Server) Watch(ctx context.Context, session string, id int, execute func(data string) error) error {
	return execute(session + "-" + strconv.Itoa(id))
}

func (Server) Stream(ctx context.Context, count int, execute func(data string) error) error {
	return execute(strconv.Itoa(count))
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestStream(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("the call's result is the argument", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events/21", nil))

		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if got := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(got, "data: 42\n\n") {
			t.Fatalf("body = %q, want it to contain %q", got, "data: 42\n\n")
		}
	})

	t.Run("the call's error responds 500 without opening the stream", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events/-1", nil))

		if rec.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		if got := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"); got == "text/event-stream" {
			t.Fatalf("Content-Type = %q, want the stream not opened", got)
		}
	})
	t.Run("a nested call takes request", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/gated/41", nil)
		req.Header.Set("Authorization", "token")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if got := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(got, "data: 42\n\n") {
			t.Fatalf("body = %q, want it to contain %q", got, "data: 42\n\n")
		}
	})

	t.Run("a nested call's error that takes request responds 500", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/gated/41", nil))

		if rec.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError {
			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
	})

	t.Run("a nested call before a path value", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/sessions/7", nil)
		req.Header.Set("Session", "abc")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

		if got := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(got, "data: abc-7\n\n") {
			t.Fatalf("body = %q, want it to contain %q", got, "data: abc-7\n\n")
		}
	})
}
